newsitem.title: GERMANY: SWIMMING-GERMANY SET WORLD BEST 4X50 RELAY TIME.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-GERMANY SET WORLD BEST 4X50 RELAY TIME.

text.p: Germany set a world best time in the women's 4x50 metres short-course medley relay on Sunday at the European sprints and short-course swimming championships.

The German team of Antje Buschschulte, Sylvia Gerasch, Julia Voitowitsch and Sandra Voelker clocked one minute 51.79 seconds to beat the previous mark of 1:52.44 set by another German quartet in Espoo, Finland, on November 21, 1992.
